name: login-helper-target
title: macOS 11–12 launch-at-login helper target
description: Parked, not started. macOS 11–12 launch-at-login currently ships as a launchd user agent at ~/Library/LaunchAgents/local.FlowTrace.login.plist (see FlowTrace/Feature/Settings/LaunchAtLoginManager.swift). The Apple-sanctioned pre-13 alternative is a helper .app embedded in Contents/Library/LoginItems/ and registered with SMLoginItemSetEnabled. It was deliberately not built: it needs a new Xcode target, an embed copy-files phase, nested-bundle signing, and a stable code-signing identity — none of which could be build-verified in the authoring sandbox. Recorded so the option is not lost. See design.md for the full spec.
creator: FlowTrace Research

meta.status_reason: Needs a new Xcode target plus nested-bundle signing; neither could be build-verified when the LaunchAgent path was chosen.
